A '''Neimoidian cyborg''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he commanded a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] during the [[Battle of Simocadia]]. He was killed by [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] when the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] crossed the bridge on his way to the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface.
